review_notes: Read the whole 41-line file; it contains one theorem, `bundleMapClass_comp_left` (lines 29–39). I checked its statement against the definitions it depends on in the supplied source roots: `bundleMapClass`/`bundleMap` and the fragment-level analogue `bundleMapCompose` (LeanPool/RegtsSevenster/RS/Novel/Skein/BundleMapClasses.lean, lines 44–46, 250–265, 316–318), `HomSpace.comp`/`HomSpace.comp_ofFragment` (LeanPool/RegtsSevenster/RS/Novel/Skein/HomCompose.lean, lines 51–53, 97–108), `HomSpace.ofFragment` (LeanPool/RegtsSevenster/RS/Novel/Skein/HomSpaces.lean, lines 43–45), `HomSpace.ofFragment_congr` (LeanPool/RegtsSevenster/RS/Novel/Skein/SkeinCategory.lean, lines 49–55), `Fragment.relabel` (LeanPool/RegtsSevenster/RS/Definitions.lean, lines 140–158) and `EdgeRankParameter` (LeanPool/RegtsSevenster/RS/Definitions.lean, lines 627–638). Arity bookkeeping is consistent: `bundleMapClass f e : HomSpace f.val (n + m)` is a morphism `n → m`, so `HomSpace.comp f n m u` applies it to `X : Fragment (Fin (m + u))` and yields arity `n + u`, exactly the target arity of the `relabel` on the right-hand side; the relabelling equivalence is verbatim the one in `bundleMapCompose`, including the `e.symm` on the input block, so the statement is the genuine class-level mirror its docstring describes rather than a trivial or wrongly indexed one. Degenerate cases do not empty the claim: `u = 0` (the case actually used downstream) gives `X : Fragment (Fin m)` and a relabelling of its first `m` slots by `e.symm`; `n = 0` forces `m = 0` by `Fin` cardinality and only makes `e` the unique empty equivalence; `X` is an arbitrary `(m + u)`-fragment, so there is no restricted/empty domain. The theorem is also not merely a restatement of `bundleMapClass_comp`: it treats composition with a general fragment on the right, and it is consumed non-trivially at LeanPool/RegtsSevenster/RS/Novel/Coordinates/CapPeel.lean line 455 inside `bundleCapClass_peel`. The module header's description of the coming permuted-cap application (lines 14–18) is forward-looking (`# Towards the matching cap`) and the theorem's own docstring (lines 27–28) accurately states what is proved, so I did not find a documented purpose that the statement fails to express. Limitations: I could not compile anything, and I did not review the whole library, only the definitions, the fragment-level mirror, the sibling right-hand analogue (`comp_bundleMapClass` in StarClassFactor.lean, lines 39–50) and the downstream use relevant to judging vacuity or mismatch. Naming/style differences with the sibling lemma are outside this rubric.
